creator: bengusberg
title: 'linkedin-agent-skill': 12 Claude sub-skills (/li-post, /li-comment, /li-profile, /li-human ...) for running a LinkedIn presence

tools.name: /li-post
tools.detail: One idea into a post. Three hook options from 21 formulas, one full draft, humanized before you see it

tools.name: /li-comment
tools.detail: Comments on other people's posts; nine types picked by what the post actually is; never 'Great post!'

tools.name: /li-reply
tools.detail: Sorts every comment on your post into lead/substance/peer/support/noise, then writes in that order

tools.name: /li-profile
tools.detail: Scores your profile against a 12-part rubric out of 100, then rewrites in fix-first order

tools.name: /li-plan
tools.detail: The week: what to post, when, and the 10 people to engage with; writes ~/.claude/linkedin/plan.md

tools.name: /li-human
tools.detail: The humanizer: two scripts that actually run (removes AI tells like em-dashes)

tools.name: /li-carousel, /li-repurpose, /li-dm, /li-triage, /li-audit
tools.detail: document/carousel posts; repurpose video/newsletter/transcript into a week of posts; 200-char invite note + follow-ups; triage inbox; post-mortem on published posts by engagement

claims: Connect Claude to LinkedIn and it'll 'run your entire account for you' (hyperbole; it's prompt skills, not an API connection)
12 mini skills, each with a different job
Posts drafted from 21 viral hook formats
Humanizer skill removes Claude's 'watermark' and AI tells like em-dashes
how_to_steps: Go to the GitHub repo Jakeschincariol/linkedin-agent-skill
Copy the URL into Claude and ask it to help you install
Use /li-profile to score and rewrite your profile, /li-plan for the week, /li-post to draft, /li-human to de-AI the text
on_screen_only: Title card: 'How to use Claude for LinkedIn'
cta: Try it out and let me know what you build; follow

relevance.why: Founder marketing on LinkedIn is a real need and this is a ready-made Claude skill set; but it is content generation, not app building, and 'runs your account' is overstated -- no posting automation.

implement_score.why: Worth a 20-minute install if LinkedIn is part of the distribution plan; /li-repurpose (turn one transcript into a week of posts) and /li-human are the high-value pieces. Low cost, moderate payoff.

verify: Does the repo exist, who is Jake Schincariol, is it maintained?
Does it actually connect to LinkedIn (API/MCP) or only produce text to paste manually?
Check the humanizer scripts for anything that executes locally (security review before install)
